card.name: Scattered words before expected continuations
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted short words such as 'local', 'be', 'can', 'are' and a period after an initial.

modes.label: 'local' in disposal wording
modes.description: The word 'local' after 'in accordance with' in disposal instructions.
modes.example: Dispose any unused medicinal product in accordance with<< local>> requirements.

modes.label: Helper verbs
modes.description: Short verbs like 'be', 'can', 'are' or 'able' in running prose.
modes.example: The contribution of bosentan in these cases could not<< be>> excluded.

card.plain: It fires on a mix of small unrelated words, so there is no pattern a reader could rely on.
